messages:
Priya Sinha: Hey team — we need a quota bump for GPU VMs in us-west-2 and a review of our k8s nodepool limits. Hitting ENI/ip limits when we scale GPU nodes.
Alex Weber: Which GPU family + counts? p4d or a100?
Priya Sinha: Looking to spin up 12 x a100 (8x) instances to run batch evals + 4 p4d for latency tests. So ~16 GPU nodes initially.
Dan Chen: FYI AWS ENI limits per instance type are causing pod density problems. a100 instances only have X ENIs, so max pods per node is capped. We can either increase ENI quota or change CNI config (aws-vpc-cni) to use prefix delegation.
Samira Gomez: Can you paste the error logs? I saw Kubelet refusing pods with "no IPs available" last night.
Priya Sinha: Here — cluster events: ```Warning FailedCreatePodSandbox pod/serve-0 "failed to create pod network sandbox: failed to allocate ip for cni"```
Alex Weber: Ok. Two parallel asks: 1) Request account QUOTAS in AWS for ENIs and secondary IPs in us-west-2 for that account (we're currently at 50 ENIs region-wide). 2) Open case with AWS support to raise ENI per-instance family limits if needed.
Dan Chen: We should also check kubelet --max-pods and CNI maxPods settings. For ip-per-pod CNI, pod density ~= number of secondary IPs per instance * ENI count. Example terraform snippet to set prefix delegation: ```terraform module "vpc-cni" { source = "git::ssh://git@.../aws-vpc-cni" enable_prefix_delegation = true }```
Samira Gomez: Another mitigation is to lower pod density by running fewer pods per GPU and using a DaemonSet GPU collector, or run a GPU node pool with larger instance count but lower pods/node. Tradeoff: more nodes -> higher instance-hour cost.
Priya Sinha: Cost ask — estimate: 12 a100 (p4) @ $X/hr => monthly ~ $Y (ballpark). We need finance OK for temporary spike. Can infra produce a quick cost calc?
Alex Weber: I'll run numbers and file a support ticket. My plan: escalate quota request for "Elastic Network Interfaces" and "Secondary private IP addresses" to limit 500, ask AWS to review ENI per-instance-family for p4/a100. Also request spot limits bump for GPU if we need cheaper capacity.
infra-bot: @channel Support case created: CASE-2026-5692 — "ENI/Secondary IP quota increase (us-west-2)". Estimated response: 48-72h. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/C-0XXXXXX
Dan Chen: Can we also change CNI config to set eniConfig with prefix delegation for the new nodepool? That should buy immediate headroom. Add to kustomize patch: ```yaml apiVersion: apps/v1 kind: DaemonSet metadata: name: aws-node spec: template: spec: containers: - name: aws-node env: - name: ENABLE_PREFIX_DELEGATION value: "true" ```
Samira Gomez: Agree. We'll do both: prefix delegation + quota request. If AWS rejects the ENI family exception, fallback is to split GPU workload across regions (us-east-1) — but that has cross-region data transfer and SLO implications.
Priya Sinha: Cool. Action items: Alex file quota/support + cost calc, Dan add CNI prefix delegation patch + test on staging nodepool (4 a100), Samira coordinate finance/ops for cost approval. I'll update ticket thread with results. :thumbsup:
Alex Weber: Filed: support case CASE-2026-5692, sent finance estimate to @Samira. Starting cost calc now.
Dan Chen: I'll create a staging nodepool with --max-pods lowered and ENABLE_PREFIX_DELEGATION true, then run small rollout. Will report back.
Samira Gomez: Got it. Will hold on approvals until we see staging results.
Priya Sinha: Thanks all.
